request.description:
### Add Movie Upload

This endpoint allows superadmins to upload a new movie along with its associated media assets.

#### Request Body

- `landscapePoster` (file, required): Image file for the landscape poster of the movie.
    
- `portraitPoster` (file, required): Image file for the portrait poster of the movie.
    
- `subTitle` (file, required): SRT file for the movie's subtitles.
    
- `trailer` (file, required if `trailerLink` is absent): Video file for the movie trailer.
    
- `video` (file, required if `videoLink` is absent): Video file for the movie.
    
- `data` (text): Additional data related to the movie.
    

formData.data type conforms to this JOI validation Schema.

> All files are mounted directly on the formData object. eg formdate.append('landscapePoster', imageFile | BLOB) and not the formdata.data property so formdata.data.landscapePoster will throw a 400 error 
  

``` javascript
Joi.object({
  title: STRING_SCHEMA.required(),
  pg: STRING_SCHEMA.required(),
  releasedDate: ISO_STRING_SCHEMA.required(),

  // enums
  category: MONGO_DB_OBJECT_ID_ARRAY_SCHEMA.required(),
  genre: MONGO_DB_OBJECT_ID_ARRAY_SCHEMA.max(3).required(),
  cast: MONGO_DB_OBJECT_ID_ARRAY_SCHEMA.max(10).required(),

  // maps to details in UI
  description: STRING_SCHEMA.required(),

  runtime: STRING_SCHEMA,
  defaultRating: STRING_SCHEMA.pattern(FLOATS_REG),

  // files
  landscapePoster: Joi.object().required(),
  portraitPoster: Joi.object().required(),

  trailer: Joi.object().optional(), // file
  trailerLink: STRING_SCHEMA.optional(),

  active: Joi.boolean(),
  showViews: Joi.boolean(),

  video: Joi.object().optional(), //file
  videoLink: STRING_SCHEMA.optional(),
  vidClass: STRING_SCHEMA.valid('free', 'ad', 'exclusive', 'premium').required(),

  expiryDate: ISO_STRING_SCHEMA,
})
  .xor('trailerLink', 'trailer')
  .xor('video', 'videoLink')

 ```

#### Response

The response for this request is a JSON object conforming to the following schema:

``` json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "status": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "message": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "movieId": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  }
}

 ```

This endpoint allows you to add new seasons for a specific video by making an HTTP POST request to {{RP_baseurl}}/superadmin/uploads/seasons/add/:videoId. The request should be sent with form-data as the request body type, and it should include the following parameters:

1. portraitPhoto (file, optional but must be provided with landscapePhoto) - The portrait photo for the season.
    
2. landscapePhoto (file, optional but must be provided with portraitPhoto) - The landscape photo for the season.
    
3. trailer (file, optional but can't be provided with trailerLink) - The trailer video file for the season.
    
4. trailerLink (text, optional but can't be provided with trailer) - The link to the trailer video for the season.
    

The response to this request will have a status code of 200 and a content type of application/json. The response body will contain the following fields:

- status (number) - Indicates the status of the request.
    
- message (string) - Provides any additional information or error messages.
    
- data (null) - Represents the data for the newly added season, which is null in this case.
    

The formdata request body must conform to the Joi schema beow.

``` javascript
 Joi.object({
  trailerLink: Joi.string(),
  portraitPhoto: Joi.object(),
  landscapePhoto: Joi.object(),
  trailer: Joi.object(),
})
  .and('portraitPhoto', 'landscapePhoto')
  .xor('trailerLink', 'trailer')

 ```

This endpoint allows you to add new seasons for a specific video by making an HTTP POST request to {{RP_baseurl}}/superadmin/uploads/seasons/add/:videoId. The request should be sent with form-data as the request body type, and it should include the following parameters:

1. portraitPhoto (file, optional but must be provided with landscapePhoto) - The portrait photo for the season.
    
2. landscapePhoto (file, optional but must be provided with portraitPhoto) - The landscape photo for the season.
    
3. trailer (file, optional but can't be provided with trailerLink) - The trailer video file for the season.
    
4. trailerLink (text, optional but can't be provided with trailer) - The link to the trailer video for the season.
    

The response to this request will have a status code of 200 and a content type of application/json. The response body will contain the following fields:

- status (number) - Indicates the status of the request.
    
- message (string) - Provides any additional information or error messages.
    
- data (null) - Represents the data for the newly added season, which is null in this case.
    

The formdata request body must conform to the Joi schema beow.

``` javascript
 Joi.object({
  trailerLink: Joi.string(),
  portraitPhoto: Joi.object(),
  landscapePhoto: Joi.object(),
  trailer: Joi.object(),
})
  .and('portraitPhoto', 'landscapePhoto')
  .xor('trailerLink', 'trailer')

 ```

This endpoint allows the superadmin to add a new season for a specific video by making an HTTP POST request to the specified URL. The request should include the necessary parameters to add the season, and the response will provide the outcome of the operation.

### Request Body

- `seasonName` (text): The name of the new season.
    
- `releaseDate` (text): The release date of the new season.
    
- `description` (text): The description of the new season.
    

### Response

Upon successful addition of the new season, the response will contain the relevant success message or status code. In case of any errors, the response will include an error message or status code to indicate the issue.

Joi.object({
  title: STRING_SCHEMA.required(),

  videoLink: STRING_SCHEMA.optional(),

  video: Joi.object().optional(), // file

})
  .xor('trailerLink', 'trailer')
